subject: sounds
title: Bossy r sounds
about: Hear the three bossy-r vowel sounds and tap the word that has one: /ar/ as in car, /or/ as in corn, /er/ as in her, bird and fur. CKLA Unit 4 teaches the spellings er, ar and or; the listening is NC RF.1.3.c (isolating the middle vowel sound) and the spelling-sound link is RF.1.4, since NC names no separate r-controlled sub-code.
tip: Say the word and hold the middle (caaar, cooorn, herrr): when r comes after a vowel it bosses the vowel into a new sound.

cards.sayQ: Which word has the are sound you hear in car?
cards.note: barn has the ar sound, like car. The r bosses the a.
